Jing-Zhang Railway Nankou–Badaling section (7th batch national key heritage site, Beijing Municipal Cultural Heritage Bureau): 1905 start / 1909 opening, Zhan Tianyou as chief engineer, the 人-shaped switchback at Qinglongqiao. Cross-checked: People's Daily 2024-11-13 front page (completed 1909-09-24), NRA 'century classic' page (first Chinese-surveyed/designed/built/managed trunk railway), Xinhua 2019 (33 per-mille Guangou gradient; 1,091 m Badaling tunnel, vertical-shaft method), Beijing Daily 2020 (domestic funding). Confidence: high.

Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park facts: surface corridor released by the HSR going underground through the 6.02 km Qinghuayuan Tunnel (opened 2019-12-30); Wudaokou launch section 2019; international planning solicitation 2019-2020; Phase I opened June 2023 (yllhj.beijing.gov.cn); Phase II approved 2024 (Beijing NDRC) and fully opened along the line in August 2026 (Beijing Daily). Confidence: high.

Old Qinghuayuan Railway Station: station of the historic Jing-Zhang line with plaque inscribed by Zhan Tianyou (Tsinghua History Museum); on the 1949 'entering-Beijing' red route; restored and opened to the public in March 2023 with a themed exhibition (beijing.gov.cn culture channel; People's Daily 2023-03-26; municipal heritage listing at wwj.beijing.gov.cn). Confidence: high.

Dazhongsi (Juesheng Temple): founded in the Qing Yongzheng era; national key heritage site; houses the Ming Yongle Great Bell (~46.5 t, ~230,000-character Buddhist text cast on it) and is now the Ancient Bell Museum (beijing.gov.cn museum page; china.com.cn culture; visitbeijing.com.cn). Metro Dazhongsi Station on Line 13 adjacent (bjsubway.com). Confidence: high.

Rail/transit base facts: Jing-Zhang HSR opened 2019-12-30 serving the 2022 Winter Olympics and runs underground through Haidian in the Qinghuayuan Tunnel (beijing.gov.cn 2018-11-20 tunnel breakthrough); Qinghe Station as Haidian hub with Line 13 interchange and the relocated-preserved old Qinghe station house (Beijing Daily); Dazhongsi/Wudaokou on Line 13 (bjsubway.com station pages); Xizhimen interchange of Lines 2/4/13 with Beijing North Station. Station-node roles in this package are conceptual; alignments defer to official material. Confidence: high.

King's Cross, London: 67-acre railway-lands regeneration; Google UK headquarters (kingscross.co.uk/google); Knowledge Quarter consortium (knowledgequarter.london); Granary Building hosting Central Saint Martins; Coal Drops Yard adaptive reuse (heatherwick.com). Confidence: high.
Station F, Paris: world's largest startup campus (~34,000 m2, ~1,000 startups) opened 2017 in the converted 1920s Halle Freyssinet rail freight hall. Confidence: high.

Kendall Square, Cambridge MA: MIT-adjacent innovation district cited as 'the most innovative square mile on the planet'; MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab anchor (news.mit.edu 2017); density data from Kendall Square Association fact sheet; urban-renewal origins (cambridgeredevelopment.org). Confidence: high.

Zhongguancun history: Electronics Street formed in the early 1980s (71.cn party-school reference); the State Council approved the Beijing New-Technology Industry Development Experimental Zone in 1988 — China's first national high-tech zone and predecessor of Zhongguancun Science Park (Xinhua). Xueyuan Road 'Eight Colleges' origin 1952 (Beijing Daily 2022). Haidian/Beijing AI-industry scale figures cited from Haidian government press events (zyk.bjhd.gov.cn 2025-09; beijing.gov.cn 2025-11). Confidence: high.

one-north, Singapore: a JTC Corporation-planned ~200-hectare innovation district launched in 2001; master plan associated with Zaha Hadid Architects (Singapore National Library Board). Key precincts: Biopolis (biomedical research), Fusionopolis (infocomm/media), LaunchPad @ one-north (startups). Confidence: high.

MaRS Discovery District, Toronto: one of the world's largest urban innovation hubs (~1.5 million sq ft / ~14,000 m2), a non-profit next to the University of Toronto and its teaching hospitals (marsdd.com/about). Links to the Vector Institute for AI, founded March 2017 at U of T and located at MaRS (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vector_Institute_(Canada)). Confidence: high.

Shanghai MoSu Space (模速空间 / 大模型创新生态社区): China's first large-model professional incubator, opened September 2023 in Xuhui West Bund (徐汇西岸), planned ~10,000 m2 (Shanghai International Talent Network). The World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC / 世界人工智能大会, worldaic.com.cn) has been held annually in Shanghai since 2018, with Xuhui West Bund as a main venue. Confidence: high.
